snippet.title: Starry Station: PlanBee Demo - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
GAMEJOLT: https://gamejolt.com/games/starrystation/904001
ITCH: https://lunartechstudios.itch.io/starry-station
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/rMyZG4MpHM

Adventure through a newly abandoned Space Station called "Starry Station", a station that once took children to space. Journey through this place to find a way to space while trying to find the reason for its closure with your new pal, "Cosmo". Be careful, some things in here do tend to bite.

In this Demo, we plan to limit the game to Twizzle Wizzle's Area! A fun, explorative kitchen that allows people to have incredible tasting foods, and to learn how to cook crazy food! However, this turns dark as over time the main chef stalks his next meal more and more...

*Coming in 2026...*
---
VIEW THE LTS LINKS: https://solo.to/lunartechstudios
PATERON: https://www.patreon.com/c/MoonLightX1
---
*Thank you for watching this trailer, and please share this with your friends! ❤️*
